Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Shobhit Saharia with Ms. Sangeeta Bhardwaj, learned counsel for the Petitioners.
2. Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned Standing Counsel for the Union of India.

3. Ms. Arushi Batra, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for the Respondent nos. 2 to 4.
4.

Mr. Jasmeet Singh, learned counsel for the Respondent no.5 through V.C.
5.

Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the Respondent no.6.
6.

The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is filed by the Petitioners to quash the FIR Case Crime No.RC0072024A0007/2024, Police Station - ACB Dehradun, under Section 120B, r/w Section 201, 409 & 420 of IPC, Sections 7, 8, 13(2) r/w Section 13(1)(a) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 dated 10.06.2024 and to quash the summon order sent by the Directorate of Enforcement, Sub- Zonal Office, Dehradun dated 26.11.2025.

entities.text: Directorate of Enforcement, Sub- Zonal Office, Dehradun
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Along with the present petition, Petitioners filed stay application seeking stay the effect and operation of summoning order dated 26.11.2025.

7. Heard.
8.
Admit.

9. Objections, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.
10.

List this matter on 19.03.2026.
11.

In the meantime, the effect and operation of the summoning order dated 26.11.2025 sent by the Directorate of Enforcement, Sub-Zonal Office, Dehradun, shall remain stayed, subject to the condition that the Petitioners shall continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of their statements.
